plugins.name: Google Search
plugins.description: Search the web from SurfSense and read the results.
plugins.author: SurfSense
plugins.about: Search the web from SurfSense to bring current results into your chats and sources, so answers can draw on what the web says today, not only on your files. Searches go through SearXNG, an open-source metasearch engine: SurfSense’s own instance, unless you set your firm’s. Useful for checking current facts, comparing options, or finding the pages worth reading on a topic.

plugins.name: Web Crawl
plugins.description: Read a public web page as clean text.
plugins.author: SurfSense
plugins.about: Read the web as clean, readable text. Open any public page from your own computer, then summarize it, compare it with others, ask questions about it or add it to your sources. Useful for summarizing articles, comparing products across sites, or answering questions from a product’s documentation. Pages behind a login or a paywall stay out of reach.

plugins.name: YouTube
plugins.description: Read YouTube videos through their transcripts.
plugins.author: SurfSense
plugins.about: Work with YouTube videos without watching every one. SurfSense reads a public video’s transcript over your own connection, so you can summarize a talk or tutorial, pull quotes from an interview, or add the video to your sources.
